description: Canonical user or virtual person-like resource shared across Tempo.Blazor components.

members.name: Id
members.description: Stable user identifier within the source and tenant scope.

members.name: DisplayName
members.description: Display name shown in user-facing UI.

members.name: Color
members.description: Optional color token or sanitized CSS color used for avatars and timelines.

members.name: IsVirtual
members.description: True when this represents a virtual resource rather than an account-backed user.

members.name: SourceKey
members.description: Optional provider/source discriminator for applications with multiple people sources.

members.name: TenantId
members.description: Optional tenant, workspace, or application scope identifier.

members.name: ToRef
members.description: Creates a lightweight reference snapshot from this user.

members.name: FromRef
members.description: Creates a full user model from a lightweight reference snapshot.
